motion.list_stagger: staggered entrance animations for table rows and grid items

components.navigation: Left sidebar or top navbar with clear hierarchy, Logo, Nav Links (Dashboard, Notes, Invoices, E-Way Bills, Customers), and a User Profile component. Desktop: Always visible. Mobile: Hamburger menu.
components.tables: Shadcn UI Tables for Invoices/Quotations/Customers. Left-aligned text, generous row padding (py-4), sticky header.
components.forms: Shadcn Forms. Use floating labels or distinct overlines. Notes entry uses a large Textarea with an 'OCR Scan' secondary button next to it.
components.toast_notifications: Sonner. For WhatsApp Mock Notifications, style the toast to resemble a WhatsApp message pop-up (green accent, app icon).
components.badges: Rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold for status (Paid, Pending, Overdue, Generated).

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5, slightly oversized (w-5 h-5 for body, w-6 h-6 for headers).

images.description: Minimalist geometric representation for brand logo

images.placement: User profile avatar in header or settings

images.description: Minimalist placeholder image for empty states (no invoices, no notes)

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text over background must meet APCA or WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum.
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: All interactive elements must have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-[#81B29A].
accessibility_and_testing.test_attributes: Add data-testid to all buttons, links, form inputs, and key UI elements (e.g., data-testid='generate-invoice-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Manrope for headings and Inter for body text via Google Fonts.
Implement a clean, data-dense Control Room layout (Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy) using the defined color palette.

Build the dashboard with Shadcn components (Cards, Tables, Forms, Dialogs). Customize Shadcn default styles to match the 'Organic & Earthy' theme (e.g., warmer greys, slightly rounded corners, soft shadows).
For the 'Notes Entry', build a split view or modal featuring a large text area and a prominent 'Extract via OCR' button.
For 'Invoice Generation', build a form that produces a Tally/GST format layout. Add a 'Generate E-Way Bill' one-click button in the invoice view.
Implement Sonner toasts styled like WhatsApp notifications for 'WhatsApp Reminders/Notification' mocks.
DO NOT use raw <input> or <select> elements. Always use Shadcn components.
Do not use transparent headers without backdrop-blur.
